name: Size and Weight
instructions: Do the warehouse measurements meet the courier's size and weight limits? Use the supplied measurements, not a visual size estimate.

choices.description: All measured dimensions and gross weight are within the limits.
At least one measured dimension or gross weight exceeds its limit.
Required measurements are unavailable.

name: Shipping Label
instructions: Does the photograph show an attached, readable shipping label with sender, recipient, tracking number, and barcode? Judge the photographed parcel only.

choices.description: The required shipping label and fields are visible and readable.
The shown parcel has no shipping label, or its label is incomplete, obscured, or unreadable.
The photograph does not provide enough evidence to assess the label.

name: Packaging Material
instructions: Is the parcel packaged in a rigid corrugated cardboard shipping box? Assess material here; assess damage and sealing separately.

choices.description: A rigid corrugated cardboard shipping box is used.
The packaging material does not meet that requirement.
The packaging material cannot be determined.

name: Exterior Condition
instructions: Are the box's visible faces and corners structurally sound, without crushed corners, significant tears, or holes? Minor surface marks alone are acceptable.

choices.description: The visible exterior is structurally sound.
Visible crushing, significant tears, or holes weaken the box.
The exterior cannot be assessed from the photograph.

name: Sealing
instructions: Are the top flaps closed and the main seam securely taped, without open gaps or loose flaps? Tape crossing an open seam does not satisfy the requirement.

choices.description: Flaps are closed and the main seam is securely taped with no open gaps.
An open gap, loose flap, or inadequate seam closure is visible.
The photograph does not show enough of the closure.

name: Internal Protection
instructions: Does the warehouse inspection record establish suitable contents, immobilization, and adequate internal cushioning? Do not invent internal details from the exterior photograph.

choices.description: The inspection record confirms suitable, immobilized, cushioned contents.
The inspection record establishes unsuitable contents or inadequate internal protection.
The required contents or internal protection inspection facts are absent.

name: Shipping Decision
instructions: Apply all six courier requirements to this parcel. Should it ship now, require remediation, or require further inspection? A known failure takes precedence over missing evidence.

choices.description: Every courier requirement is satisfied by the photograph and inspection record.
At least one courier requirement fails; remediate before shipping.
No failure is established, but evidence for at least one required criterion is missing.
